prowl-breath-1.text: Ragged wet rasping breathing of a very sick person, slow inhale and exhale, close. Outdoors at night, natural, no music, no words, no voice.

prowl-breath-9.text: Raspy hungry breathing that speeds up, then a low growl, then slows again. Outdoors at night, natural, no music, no words, no voice.
